content: To tokenize a Vietnamese word, in HMM or ME, authors only rely on features around a word segment position. Some other features are also affected by adding more special attributes, such as, in case ’?’ question mark at end of sentence, Part of Speech (POS), and so on. Conditional Random Fields is one of methods that uses additional features to improve the selection strategy BIBREF7 .
